title: bug: hot reload has a check-to-exec race after verifying committed wrapper bytes
description:
Adversarial review of 5998f871: both wrappers verify git diff, then parse/deregister/reload the mutable pathname. A write after the successful diff can therefore be loaded without being committed.
Scratch /mnt/d/moe-scratch/r-5998f871/probe-race.sh uses the real sh gate and a git shim that runs real diff then appends before returning rc0: gate returns RELOAD while immediate real git diff HEAD returns 1. Investigate a pinned-byte reload design; current approved plan explicitly preserves parse/handover bodies.

implementationPlan.description:
TEST FIRST, sh twin + shared knob (RED before any wrapper edit).
(a) scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js, `case 'deregister_worker'`: add knob FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_SRC / FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_DST, documented at the handler like the other FAKE_* knobs. When `args.reason === 'wrapper_restart'` and SRC exists, BEFORE ok(): `fs.writeFileSync(DST, fs.readFileSync(SRC))` (rewrites the existing wrapper in place, no rename), then `fs.unlinkSync(SRC)` (one-shot). The deregister is synchronous in both wrappers, so this write lands after the committed check and the parse but before the hand-over loads bytes. That is the check-to-exec window, independent of which git commands the fix runs.
Error handling: let an fs error throw. The arm asserts SRC was consumed, so a swallowed deregister failure cannot pass vacuously.
(b) scripts/tests/postflight.sh: new arm `[hot reload race] a write after the committed check is never loaded`.
- Placement: after the deferred/unverifiable loop, before [stale offset].
- Reuse RELOAD_DIR/RELOAD_PROJECT/RELOAD_WRAPPER and reload_repo/reload_commit/reload_wait/reload_seq/reload_fail.
- Setup is the same as the deferred arm, plus a private RACE_TMP=$RELOAD_DIR/tmp.
- Before launch, a node one-liner prepares two contents. Edit A = original + '# race A\n'. $RELOAD_DIR/race.src = edit A with the single 'Agent idle, checking for tasks in' replaced by 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}, checking for tasks in'. Exit non-zero unless exactly one occurrence.
- Launch like [hot reload], adding TMPDIR=$RACE_TMP FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_SRC=$RELOAD_DIR/race.src FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_DST=$RELOAD_WRAPPER (FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=idle MOE_DISABLE_HEARTBEAT=1 --loop --poll-interval 1).

Phase A:
- Write edit A, reload_commit 'race A', reload_wait 1 '^c+rc{3,}$'.
- Fail unless race.src is gone, the wrapper contains MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED, and `reload_git diff --quiet -- moe-agent.sh` exits 1.
- reload_fail 'the restart loaded bytes written after the committed check' if the seat output contains MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED.

Phase B:
- reload_commit 'race write', reload_wait 2 '^c+rc+rc{3,}$'.
- Require an output line matching 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from .*/moe-wrapper-pin\.[^/]+/moe-agent\.sh,' (committed bytes load, from a private copy).

Phase C:
- node renames every MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE to MOE_WRAPPER_ORIGIN in the wrapper (fail if none).
- reload_commit 'drop hand-over', reload_wait 3 '^c+rc+rc+rc{3,}$'.
- Require grep -F "MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from $RELOAD_WRAPPER," (bytes without the hand-over reload from the checkout path).
- Require that no moe-wrapper-pin.* entry is left in RACE_TMP.

Kill the seat and restore LIVE_PIDS as the sibling arms do, then print '[hot reload race] ok: ...'.
RED: S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/red-69c02444.XXXXXX) && git archive HEAD scripts .github/workflows/ci.yml | tar -x -C "$S", copy in ONLY these two test files, then run the gate's postflight.sh invocation there. Expect exit 1 at this arm with that message, every earlier arm ok. Keep the log for the completion summary.

TEST FIRST, ps1 twin (RED). The twin arm goes in scripts/tests/postflight.ps1 after its deferred/unverifiable loop. Same three phases and assertions, built on Invoke-ReloadCommit / Get-ReloadSequence / Wait-ReloadSequence / Set-ReloadWrapperText.
- Write race.src with the same UTF-8 BOM encoding Set-ReloadWrapperText uses. Replace 'Agent idle, checking for tasks in' with 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from $PSCommandPath, checking for tasks in' (single-quoted literal; exactly one occurrence).
- Launch via Start-Process exactly like the [hot reload] arm, with $env:TMP and $env:TEMP pointed at a private dir and $env:FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_SRC/_DST set. Restore or remove every one of them in the existing finally pattern, so later arms see the original environment.
- Phase B requires a log match for 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from .*moe-wrapper-pin\.[^\\/]+[\\/]moe-agent\.ps1,'.
- Phase C renames every MoeWrapperSourcePath to MoeWrapperOrigin. It then requires 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from <reload wrapper path>,', compared case-insensitively ($PSCommandPath may differ in case), and no moe-wrapper-pin.* left in the private temp dir.
Error handling: taskkill/Stop-Process cleanup in finally, as the sibling arms do. Throw 'HOT RELOAD RACE FAILED: ...' with the RPC sequence and the seat log on any failed check, using the same 'loaded bytes written after the committed check' text for phase A.
RED: run postflight.ps1 via powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $(wslpath -w ...) in the step-1 RED snapshot, with this file copied in. It must fail at this arm. Keep the log.

sh runtime, scripts/moe-agent.sh: pinned reload.

(1) Top, replacing the SCRIPT_DIR line:
- MOE_WRAPPER_FILE=${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}.
- ONLY when that path lies in a */moe-wrapper-pin.*/ folder, use ${MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE:-...} (the checkout path a hot reload hands over).
- ALWAYS `unset MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE`, so no child ever inherits it.
- SCRIPT_DIR from dirname of MOE_WRAPPER_FILE.

(2) At the reload block:
- MOE_WRAPPER_PATH="$SCRIPT_DIR/${MOE_WRAPPER_FILE##*/}" (absolute).
- MOE_WRAPPER_LAUNCH_HASH = sha256 of the file this process actually loaded (${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}, the copy when pinned). A write after the hand-over can never become the launch hash, and launch == live for a clean checkout, so there is no thrash.
- Then, only when that loaded file differs from MOE_WRAPPER_PATH: best-effort `rm -f` of it and `rmdir` of its folder. Bash holds the script open, and the {...exit} group reads on from that descriptor (prototyped).

(3) wrapper_reload_deferred keeps the 5998f871 ls-files/diff gate and its messages unchanged. When diff is clean it pins:
- mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/moe-wrapper-pin.XXXXXX" (0700); cp the wrapper into it under the same leaf.
- Require `git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" hash-object --path=<leaf> -- <copy>` to equal `git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>`. These are the same clean filters diff uses; verified on git 2.43 with a CRLF copy.
- On success, return 1 with MOE_WRAPPER_PIN=<copy>. MOE_WRAPPER_PIN is reset at the top of every call.
- A blob mismatch (a write between diff and cp) defers with the rc-1 'uncommitted edits' message.
- A failed mktemp/cp defers with 'cannot confirm the wrapper bytes are committed (private copy failed)'.
- A rev-parse/hash-object failure defers with '(git rev-parse|hash-object exited N)'.
- A copy that lacks the string MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE (bytes that predate or revert this hand-over, and would resolve helpers beside the copy) is dropped. The call returns 1 with MOE_WRAPPER_PIN empty, which means a legacy reload of the checkout path.

(4) Reload branch:
- `bash -n "${MOE_WRAPPER_PIN:-$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH}"`.
- One helper drops the pin. It removes only a moe-wrapper-pin.* folder and clears the variable. Call it on parse refusal (the refused hash is the parsed bytes' hash) and on the MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue.
- After deregister and the SECURE_TEMP_DIR removal, when pinned: `MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE="$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH" exec "$BASH" "$MOE_WRAPPER_PIN" "${MOE_WRAPPER_ARGV[@]}"`. Otherwise `exec "$BASH" "$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH" ...`. Keep the failure echo.
- cleanup_temp drops a staged pin (type -t guard, like its siblings).

Error handling: every new command uses the `|| rc=$?` pattern, so set -e can never end the seat inside the check. Every failure defers and keeps serving the current bytes. Announcement, deregister reason and stop/deregister order stay byte-identical.

ps1 runtime, scripts/moe-agent.ps1: pinned reload (prototyped on PS 5.1).

(1) Supervisor at the top:
- $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath = $PSCommandPath for the loop's life.
- Reset $global:MoeWrapperReload and $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin before each pass.
- Run $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin when the previous pass set it, else $PSCommandPath.
- Once a pass that ran a copy returns, remove the copy's folder. Only a moe-wrapper-pin.* leaf; -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; capture $LASTEXITCODE first.
- The finally clears $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath and removes a staged copy no pass ran.
- The catch/throw and the 'wrapper relaunch failed' text stay.

(2) Directly after the supervisor block:
- $script:MoeWrapperPath = $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath if set, else $PSCommandPath.
- $script:MoeScriptRoot = Split-Path -Parent of it, else $PSScriptRoot.
- Replace every other $PSScriptRoot with $script:MoeScriptRoot: proxy root, daemon root, $pluginRoot, prompt-cache.mjs, moe-account-lease.mjs, both mods dirs, plus any a peer added meanwhile.
- Delete the later `$script:MoeWrapperPath = $PSCommandPath` line.

(3) Launch hash from [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($PSCommandPath): the bytes this pass loaded.

(4) Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred keeps its ls-files/diff gate and messages. When diff is clean:
- If $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath is unset (a pre-fix supervisor reruns the checkout path), return $false with no copy.
- Else read the wrapper bytes once and [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes them to <[IO.Path]::GetTempPath()>/moe-wrapper-pin.<guid N>/<leaf>.
- Require Invoke-MoeGit `rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>` and `hash-object --path=<leaf> -- <copy>` to both return Rc 0 and the same id. Then set $script:MoeWrapperPin and return $false.
- Mismatch, failure and marker rules are the same as the sh twin: no 'MoeWrapperSourcePath' in the copy means a legacy reload with no copy. Reason texts are identical, including 'private copy failed'.

(5) Reload branch:
- ParseFile the copy when set.
- Remove it on refusal and on the MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue.
- At the hand-over, set $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin = $script:MoeWrapperPin before `break`, so the supervisor can remove it even if the bottom hand-over is skipped. The bottom `$global:MoeWrapperReload = $true` stays.

Error handling: the copy block runs inside the existing try/catch. Any exception defers with '(private copy failed: <message>)' and never ends or deregisters the seat. Preserve the UTF-8 BOM and LF endings.

Docs: scripts/CLAUDE.md, the Hot reload bullet only.
- After the ls-files/diff sentence, say that a reload never loads the shared path. It copies the bytes into a private moe-wrapper-pin.* temp folder, requires the copy's blob (`git hash-object --path=<leaf>`) to equal `HEAD:<leaf>`, parses the copy, and runs it. sh: `exec "$BASH" <copy>` with MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE naming the checkout. ps1: the supervisor runs $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin, and helpers resolve beside $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath. So a write after the check stays unloaded until committed (task-69c02444).
- Copy failure defers with '(private copy failed)'.
- Committed bytes that do not name the hand-over reload from the checkout path (revert-safe).
- A ps1 seat launched before this change keeps its old supervisor until relaunched.
- The sh copy deletes itself once loaded; the ps1 supervisor deletes it after the pass.
- Update the tests sentence to the five [hot reload*] arms, naming [hot reload race].
Keep the bullet terse; no other doc edits.

Verification: run ONCE, fresh, in a snapshot. Never npm build/test in the shared checkout. The command (also checkRefs):
cd /mnt/d/projexts/moes && mkdir -p /mnt/d/moe-scratch && S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/v-69c02444.XXXXXX) && git archive HEAD scripts .github/workflows/ci.yml | tar -x -C "$S" && for f in scripts/moe-agent.sh scripts/moe-agent.ps1 scripts/tests/postflight.sh scripts/tests/postflight.ps1 scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js scripts/CLAUDE.md; do cp "$f" "$S/$f" && cmp "$f" "$S/$f" || exit 1; done && printf 'Verification snapshot: %s\n' "$S" && cd "$S" && bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && env $(env | awk -F= '/^(MOE_|CLAUDE)/{printf "-u %s ", $1}') MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180 bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && WSLENV=MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180 powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$(wslpath -w "$S/scripts/tests/postflight.ps1")"
If it outlives the tool timeout, run it in the background with `tee` to a log and report exit code + tail.
- Expected: exit 0. `[hot reload race] ok` in BOTH twins, and every pre-existing [hot reload*] / [stale offset] arm still ok with unchanged assertions.
- complete_task evidence: this command, its exit code and tail, plus the two RED logs from steps 1-2.
- Budget: net non-board diff ≤300 LOC (QA cap 400, tests included). Report per-file +/- in the completion summary.

Adversarial self-review: one pass over the whole diff, before complete_task.
(a) Can any path load bytes that were not verified? Grep every exec/`&` hand-over; the copy must be written and verified before parse, sidecar stop and deregister.
(b) Thrash: launch hash == hash of the loaded bytes. A clean checkout never re-reloads, and Phase A shows exactly one restart.
(c) Deletion safety: only moe-wrapper-pin.* folders the wrapper created. The sh self-delete is rm -f + rmdir. A stale exported MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE with a normal launch path is ignored and unset. A relative launch path still yields an absolute MOE_WRAPPER_PATH.
(d) No new failure ends or deregisters a seat (set -e, PS try/catch). Messages and parity literals are unchanged; parity-check stays green without list edits.
(e) Compat: a pre-fix ps1 supervisor gets no copy and no leak, and marker-less bytes reload from the checkout. Grep moe-agent.ps1 for $PSScriptRoot: only the MoeScriptRoot fallback may remain. Grep moe-agent.sh for BASH_SOURCE: only the top hand-over and the loaded-hash/self-delete may remain.
(f) Concurrency: two seats reloading at once get distinct mktemp/GUID folders. A write landing during cp is caught by the blob check.
(g) Windows: BOM preserved, TEMP with spaces or 8.3 names, WriteAllBytes leaves no Zone.Identifier.
Fix anything found, rerun the step-6 command, then complete_task.

Design: the wrapper copies itself to a private temp folder (moe-wrapper-pin.*), checks the copy's blob against HEAD:<leaf>, parses the copy and runs it. executionContract.intendedBehavior: A wrapper hot reload loads exactly the bytes it verified as committed. Both twins keep the 5998f871 ls-files/diff gate. Once it passes, they copy the wrapper into a private moe-wrapper-pin.* temp folder, require the copy's git blob (hash-object --path=<leaf>) to equal HEAD:<leaf>, parse the copy, and run the copy. In sh that is `exec "$BASH" <copy>`, with MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE naming the checkout. In ps1 the in-process supervisor runs $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin, and helpers resolve beside $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath. A write landing on the shared path after the check stays unloaded, and is deferred as uncommitted, until it is committed; then the seat reloads it once. Committed bytes that do not name the hand-over reload from the checkout path as before. ps1 seats under a pre-fix supervisor keep the old reload until relaunched.
acceptanceCriteria: postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 each gain a `[hot reload race]` arm. With HEAD's (pre-fix) wrappers, each fails at that arm with 'the restart loaded bytes written after the committed check' while every earlier arm passes. The RED logs are named in the completion summary.

Post-fix, in both twins, committing 'race A' yields exactly one wrapper_restart (`^c+rc{3,}$`). The fake proxy's racing write is consumed (race.src gone; the live wrapper is dirty against HEAD), and MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED is never printed while that write is uncommitted.
After the racing write is committed, the seat restarts exactly once more and prints `MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from <...>moe-wrapper-pin.<id>/moe-agent.{sh,ps1},`: it is running a private copy.

After a committed edit renames the hand-over name (MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE / MoeWrapperSourcePath), the seat restarts exactly once more and prints `MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from <checkout wrapper path>,`. Its private temp dir then holds no moe-wrapper-pin.* entry.

The existing [hot reload], [hot reload refused], [hot reload deferred], [hot reload unverifiable] and [stale offset] arms pass with their assertions unchanged. parity-check.sh passes with its literal lists unchanged.

In moe-agent.ps1, every helper path that used $PSScriptRoot goes through $script:MoeScriptRoot; grep finds $PSScriptRoot only in that variable's fallback. In moe-agent.sh, SCRIPT_DIR and MOE_WRAPPER_PATH resolve to the checkout in a pinned seat, and MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE is unset before anything else runs.
The step-6 gate command exits 0 fresh. Net non-board diff is ≤300 LOC (QA cap 400, tests included).
invariants: Under a pin-aware runtime, a reload loads only a private copy whose blob equaled HEAD:<leaf> when it was verified. Nothing reads the shared path for the load after the check.
The copy is written and verified before the parse, the heartbeat-sidecar stop and the deregister.
One restart per committed hash, never a thrash: the launch hash is the hash of the bytes actually loaded.
Every new failure defers and keeps serving the current bytes; nothing new can end or deregister a seat.
Deletion is limited to moe-wrapper-pin.* folders the wrapper created. The sh self-delete is rm -f of the loaded copy plus rmdir, never recursive on a derived path.
wrapper_restart, the restart announcement, all MOE_WRAPPER_RELOAD_* texts and the 5998f871 ls-files/diff deferral matrix are unchanged.
compatibility: sh seats running pre-fix bytes reach this change through the old exec of the checkout path; every later reload is pinned.
ps1 seats whose supervisor predates this change (no $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath) keep reloading the checkout path, with no copy made; relaunch them to get pinned reloads.
Committed bytes that do not name the hand-over (a revert) reload from the checkout path, so their $PSScriptRoot/BASH_SOURCE helpers still resolve.
.moe/ state, MCP contracts, deregister reasons and parity literals are untouched.

moe-agent.ps1: the top supervisor, $script:MoeWrapperPath/$script:MoeScriptRoot, the $PSScriptRoot call sites, the launch-hash capture, Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred, the loop-top reload branch
postflight.sh / postflight.ps1: one new [hot reload race] arm each

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Keep loading the checkout path and re-verify inside the new process: rejected. bash reads incrementally and PowerShell has already parsed by then, and there are no last-good bytes to fall back on. (2) Materialize `git cat-file blob HEAD:<path>`: rejected. Raw blob bytes can differ from the checkout under eol conversion, so the launch hash would never match the live hash and the seat would reload every iteration; copying the live bytes and verifying with hash-object --path compares like with like. (3) Race test via a git PATH shim: rejected. It depends on which git commands the fix runs, and .cmd shims are fragile under PowerShell. The fake-proxy deregister hook lands the write after every check in both twins, deterministically. (4) ps1 scriptblock from Parser.ParseInput(text, path): rejected, because `exit` inside a scriptblock ends the supervisor. (5) Copy inside scripts/ or a symlink farm: rejected. It writes into the shared checkout and still breaks old code ($SCRIPT_DIR/.., the reload hash).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Both wrappers already funnel every reload through one loop-top branch, after the poll sleep and before dispatch. The deregister is synchronous in both (moe-call.sh / Invoke-MoeRpc via MOE_PROXY_PATH), which makes it a deterministic injection point for the racing write. The ps1 supervisor is launch-time code, so passes must keep it backward compatible: the presence of $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath is the capability signal. scripts/CLAUDE.md's Hot reload bullet documents the gate commands verbatim and must change with them. parity-check lists only the prefix 'cannot confirm the wrapper bytes are committed (', so new reason texts need no list edit as long as both twins match.
planningNotes.risks:
- Revert hazard: bytes without the hand-over, run from a copy, would resolve helpers in the temp folder (deregister, landing, prompt cache). The marker fallback and Phase C cover this.
- An old ps1 supervisor would run the checkout path and leak copies: no copy is made unless $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath is set.
- A broken TMPDIR or TEMP now defers reloads with a WARN instead of loading unverified bytes.
- Locked-down Windows (AppLocker/WDAC blocking %TEMP% scripts) would make the supervisor's `&` fail with the existing 'relaunch by hand' stop.
- Self-unlink of the running sh copy relies on POSIX unlink-while-open (Linux, macOS, WSL; Cygwin/MSYS emulate it). It is best effort and a failure only leaks one ~300 KB file.
- Peers (aa85ff13, 01f37ac6, WT-12, the worktree follow step) may move lines or add $PSScriptRoot/BASH_SOURCE uses before this row is claimed. Re-grep at start and anchor on the function names. The WT follow step must stay before the reload block.
- Never derive rm targets from env without the moe-wrapper-pin.* guard.
- The test arms must consume their FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_* env and restore TMP/TEMP so later arms are unaffected.
